Figure 2:Example traces of the GiGPPO-trained planning agent and the SFT baseline on the UINavBench task: ”Find a route from Apple Park to the Santa Clara Caltrain Station.” Pink crosshairs indicate the agent’s tap and text-entry actions at each step. Because the Apple Maps workflow requires selecting the destination before the starting location, the agents are easily confused by the task prompt’s phrasing, which mentions the starting point first. The GiGPPO agent initially sets the destination as Apple Park, but it corrects itself by exiting the directions search and restarting with the Santa Clara Caltrain Station as the destination, demonstrating strong error recovery. In contrast, the SFT agent opens the wrong directions search page and gets stuck repeatedly trying to set the starting point of a custom route until it reaches the maximum step limit.

Figure 3:Example traces of the GiGPPO-trained planning agent and the SFT baseline on the complex, multi-app iOSWorld task: “Find my most recent Chipotle order in QuickBite and note the items and total. Search my Mail inbox for the QuickBite receipt email and note the receipt amount. Check my MyBank credit card transactions for the corresponding charge. Compare the amounts across all three sources (totals may differ due to tips, fees, or processing). What are the order items, QuickBite total, email receipt amount, bank charge, and any discrepancies?” Pink crosshairs indicate the agent’s tap and text-entry actions at each step, while blue arrows indicate swipe actions. Although the SFT agent opens all three apps, it fails to search them for the necessary information. In contrast, the GiGPPO agent successfully navigates through each app and locates all the required details.

Figure 4:Example traces of the PPO-trained planning agent and the PPO agent trained only on terminal rewards for the AndroidWorld task: ”Delete the following recipes from Broccoli app: Chicken Alfredo Pasta, Tomato Basil Bruschetta, Grilled Cheese with Tomato and Basil.” Pink crosshairs indicate the agent’s tap and text-entry actions at each step, while blue arrows indicate swipe actions. Because the app contains many other recipes, the PPO agent with dense rewards efficiently searches for and deletes each specified recipe. In contrast, the PPO agent without dense rewards manually scrolls through the list to locate each one, wasting numerous steps and failing to complete the task within the maximum step limit.
